description: A member-facing 案内/伴走 session for a single participation act (ADR-2605312400 §3, moushibumi_intake + moushibumi_compose). Holds the step-by-step walkthrough + 必要事項 checklist pulled from a chigiri template (G5 — drafting-assist, never legal advice). CONSTITUTIONAL: member-initiated + consent + DID/SBT bound, OWN voice only (G4); cites the target's legalBasis (G8). Holds session metadata + checklist state, not plaintext member PII or political-opinion (G6).
